verdict.rationale: Salv's OpenAPI spec defines a separate `demo` sandbox environment next to the `app` production environment, so API integrations can be tested without hitting production. The backtesting features (running scenarios against history with no real alerts) are dry-run simulation, not sandbox isolation, and are not credited toward this story. Missing for 10: documentation on sandbox provisioning, data isolation guarantees and test-data seeding, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
